competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, promotional, or refer to a different return type or product category rather than the current standard full-refund policy.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days, measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Refuted if the current authoritative policy states a different full-refund window for standard items, or if the 30-day window applies only to exchanges, non-standard items, or a different start date.
